format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this cutscene, like "level-1-intro". It matches the file name.

level.description: The level it is staged in, by id, like "level-1".

length.description: How long the cutscene lasts, in ticks. 60 ticks is one second.

at.description: The tick it happens at. 60 ticks is one second.

x.description: The middle of the picture, in tiles from the left edge of the level.

y.description: The middle of the picture, in tiles from the top edge of the level.

zoom.description: How close the camera is: 1 is the usual, 2 is twice as close.

ease.description: How it gets here: "cut" at once, "linear" steadily, "smooth" slowing at the ends.

camera.description: Where the camera is, key by key, in time order.

at.description: The tick it happens at. 60 ticks is one second.

who.description: Which thing: its id in the level, or player-1 to player-4 for a player's hero.

x.description: Where it stands, in tiles from the left edge of the level.

y.description: Where it stands, in tiles from the top edge of the level.

clip.description: The clip it plays from here on, like "talk". Left out means no change.

face.description: Which way it faces. Left out means no change.

actors.description: Where each thing stands and what it does, key by key, in time order.

at.description: The tick it happens at. 60 ticks is one second.

line.description: What is said, as a message key, like "keeper.hello".

speaker.description: The character who says it, by id, like "keeper".
